title: Rabbi Yannai the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Megillah 32a, Rabbi Yannai, son of Rabbi Yannai the Elder, reports Rabbi Yannai the Great. In Nedarim 22a, a grandson of Rabbi Yannai the Elder, through his daughter, came before Rabbi Yannai the Elder, who released his vow.

notes.text: The grandson is explicitly through Yannai’s daughter. The Elder and the Great remain separate designations in the report chain; no authority identification is made.
The consulted Nedarim passage writes Yannai Saba in full for the person approached. The Megillah transmission preserves both the Elder and the Great.
